plan.archetype: Flexible poison scaling, multihit attacks, and dexterity defense
plan.bossPrep: Strip Slippery with multihit attacks. Establish scaling and reliable block for heavy attacks. Enter healthy with defensive potions.
plan.summary: Add efficient damage early, then poison scaling, dexterity, and draw. Remove Strikes after securing damage replacements. Take elites with adequate health and potions; heal when necessary.

plan.archetype: Shuriken shivs and multihits with poison-supported dexterity defense
plan.bossPrep: Strip nine Slippery stacks with shivs and multihits. Upgrade Blade Dance or Neutralize. Bring defensive potions and enough health for heavy attacks.

plan.archetype: Poison scaling with dexterity defense and Shuriken support
plan.bossPrep: Upgrade Accelerant; establish poison on both crabs. Bring dexterity, draw, strong block, and defensive potions. Face Rocket during its laser; surviving crab remains dangerous.
plan.summary: Damage gap is uncalibrated. Use extra energy for poison and defense. Prioritize dexterity and draw; upgrade Accelerant when safe. Replace basics gradually, visit both shops, and take only the rested elite.
